summary: Innate Pharma SA filed a routine 6-K for Q2 2026 (period ended June 30, 2026), containing interim IFRS financial statements rather than a special-situation event. XBRL tags reference a strategic partnership with Swedish Orphan Biovitrum AB dated August 10, 2026, and a capital increase dated August 18, 2026, alongside balance-sheet items, the Société Générale/BNP Paribas PGE loan, and the 2014 monalizumab/NKG2A Novo Nordisk agreement. No stake, price per share, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or deal mechanics are disclosed. This is an ordinary foreign-private-issuer interim report mapped to a US quarterly report; no risk-arb angle applies.
